title: SOP front matter
description: The YAML front matter of a single SOP file. Only these fields are indexed; everything below the front matter is body text read solely when the SOP is selected.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must equal the filename without .md.

title.description: What the procedure does, in one line, as a verb phrase.

trigger.description: The situation in which this SOP applies. This is the field the dispatcher matches against, so write it as the circumstance, not the action.

autonomy.description: How much of this SOP may be executed without asking. auto = run it through; confirm = one confirmation before the first irreversible step; confirm-each = ask at every step that changes something; manual = read it out to the user and let them drive.

last_verified.description: Absolute date this procedure was last known to work end to end. Not the date the file was edited.

frequency.description: Roughly how often it runs. Feeds staleness judgement: a monthly SOP unverified for a year is suspect in a way a rare one is not.

supersedes.description: IDs of retired SOPs this one replaces.

requires.description: Tools, CLIs, credentials or MCP servers that must be present. Names only — never values.
